name: Mixtape
inspiration: One site, every finish: the Seafoam Studio grid is home, the Candy Apple particle swarm carries you between sections, and each section arrives wearing its own finish — like flipping through a mixtape of the five other themes.

hub.note: The Swiss card grid from Seafoam Studio, unchanged: masthead, 12-col grid, mono coords, pine card for guitars, seafoam for blog.

transition.note: Leaving a view, its headline shatters into particles tinted in the CURRENT section's palette; mid-swarm the particles recolor toward the TARGET section's palette and reassemble as its headline — the swarm literally carries you from one finish to the next. Reduced motion: crossfade.

projects.note: Professional case studies: each project as a browser-framed snapshot with copy beside it, alternating rows. Real screenshots where they exist (control panel dashboard/architecture, the blog maintainer console); tasteful stylized frames elsewhere.

backend.note: Swiss channel-strip list — boring on purpose, precise where it counts.

frontend.note: Dark chrome stage, condensed display, shimmer on the active item.

integrations.note: A wall of jack sockets; each item is a patch connection — a cable draws between two jacks when its entry opens. Where systems shake hands.

event-sourcing.note: The full Event Log replay: offsets, timestamps, write-head caret, Lake Placid Blue.

distributed-systems.note: The amp service manual: each item is a figure plate whose ink schematic animates its failure drill — the saga chain compensating in reverse, the valve holding the line under load (honest 429), the probe finding the out-of-range test point. Everything fails, and the manual is the plan.

iac.note: A working demo of Diego's real infra control panel: white service cards with green status dots and On/Off power pills, a mini tiered architecture strip with an animated packet flow, and a scheduling-rules table with toggle switches. Demo state is local — flipping Api off dims its node and stops the flow. The section's three items become the console's service descriptions.

guitars.note: EACH ITEM IS A STOMPBOX: three pedals in different finishes, knobs, LED, silkscreen title; stomping one lights its LED and expands its deck below the board.

blog.note: Burst masthead band, serif ledes, dated entries in the margin — a reading room.

notes.scoping: Each section view mounts inside a wrapper that carries that finish's palette/type tokens as scoped CSS custom properties — themes never leak across sections.
notes.contract: themeRefs are resolved against themes/<id>.json; a mockup embeds each referenced theme verbatim in its own script block (id="theme-<id>") so the byte-parity verification still holds per theme.
